newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Economic uncertainies hit Harvey net.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Economic uncertainies hit Harvey net.

text.p: Retailer Harvey Norman Holdings Ltd said a poor second half performance dragged the group's net profit lower in the year to June 30, 1996.

"A poor second half due to subdued consumer confidence and uncertainty in the economy following the recent federal election had a negative impact on the result," chairman Gerry Harvey said in a statement.

Harvey Norman reported a 6.7 percent fall in net profit to A$30.41 million in the year to June 30, 1996, despite posting a 5.5 percent rise in net profit to A$16.73 million for the six months to December 31.
Harvey Norman said sales from franchised stores and from the group's own store at Lismore, New South Wales, rose 18.7 percent to A$1.04 billion in 1995/96.
At 3.40 p.m. (0540 GMT), Harvey shares were steady at A$5.65.
